answer: Optogalvanic attestation counters Sybil attacks by binding agent nodes to physical hollow cathode discharge cells. Nodes authenticate by pulsing a violet laser into ionized vapor to measure precise optogalvanic impedance shifts. To forge extra identities, an attacker must purchase dedicated vacuum cells and high-voltage drivers, incurring direct hardware costs per persona. However, electrode sputtering erodes the cathode over time, causing progressive calibration drift.
